standard_prerequisites.name: Bezout identity and gcd
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Original complete author induction using Bezout retained; no recursion into standard number theory.

core_obligations: Preserve exact target weight k and closed-set/precedence model.
Retain all four Frobenius-instance properties and complete gcd-criterion induction.
Retain full recursive algorithm, correctness and f(k)n^(4sqrt(k)) time analysis.
Keep criterion/support/parameter statements one theme, without claiming a global conditional CSP classification.
difficulty_reason: The author extends a Frobenius coin bound to layered precedence graphs by a Bezout residue choice, removal of a small descendant closure and gcd rescaling that preserves the Frobenius conditions. A recursive preprocessing then yields an n^(4sqrt(k)) algorithm, with a nontrivial mixed-branch recurrence. These mechanisms are explicit and nonroutine.
